insert into Assignment
id, user_id, course_id, course_content_id, title, start, due, description, criteria, submission_num, allowed_submission_times, highest_grade, lowest_grade, average_grade, grade_publish, group_mode, group_size, full_mark, is_group, submission_required,
#{id}, #{userId}, #{courseId}, #{courseContentId}, #{title}, #{start}, #{due}, #{description}, #{criteria}, #{submissionNum}, #{allowedSubmissionTimes}, #{highestGrade}, #{lowestGrade}, #{averageGrade}, #{gradePublish}, #{groupMode}, #{groupSize}, #{fullMark}, #{isGroup}, #{submissionRequired},
mapper.select: SELECT sub.title, sub.description, sub.status FROM ( SELECT a.id, a.title, a.description, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM AssignmentSubmission WHERE assignment_id = a.id AND student_id = #{userId} ) THEN (SELECT IFNULL( (SELECT as_sub.grade FROM AssignmentSubmission as_sub WHERE as_sub.assignment_id = a.id AND as_sub.student_id = #{userId}), (SELECT "Not graded" ))) WHEN a.due < NOW() THEN 'Overdue' ELSE (SELECT a2.due FROM Assignment a2 WHERE a2.id = a.id) END AS status FROM Assignment a LEFT JOIN AssignmentSubmission asgmt_sub ON asgmt_sub.assignment_id = a.id AND asgmt_sub.student_id = #{userId} WHERE a.course_id = #{courseId} ) sub ORDER BY CASE WHEN sub.status = 'Overdue' THEN 1 WHEN sub.status NOT IN ('Overdue','Not graded') AND sub.status NOT REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN 2 WHEN sub.status = 'Not graded' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END LIMIT 5;
